title: How Does Weather Work? Rain, Rainbows, Snow and More with Gizmo
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Gizmo the robot, and welcome to Gizmo Explains!
I love asking, how does that work? Today we're going to find out how weather works.
We'll explore five cool things. Can you count them with me? One, two, three, four, five!
When my antenna lights up, it means I have an idea!

lines: Here's a clue: it falls from clouds, drip, drop! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
The sun warms water in lakes and oceans, and it floats up into the sky.
Up high, it cools down and makes clouds out of tiny drops.
Can you wiggle your fingers down like falling rain?
When cloud drops get big and heavy, they fall down!
One more time, nice and loud: RAIN!
Then the water goes back up again. It's called the water cycle!
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: it's a colorful arch in the sky! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
Sunlight looks white, but it's really made of many colors.
When sunlight shines through raindrops, the colors spread out!
Can you draw a big rainbow in the air with your finger?
What do we need to see a rainbow?
Sunshine and raindrops at the same time!
One more time, nice and loud: RAINBOW!
Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple!
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: it's a bright flash in a stormy sky! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
Lightning is a giant spark of electricity in the clouds.
It's super hot, and it makes the air go BOOM. That's thunder!
Can you count with me after a flash? One, two, three!
One more time, nice and loud: LIGHTNING!
When there's a storm, we stay safe inside.
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: it's white, cold, and falls in winter! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
When it's really cold, water in the clouds freezes into ice crystals.
The crystals stick together and make snowflakes!
Can you float down slowly, like a snowflake?
One more time, nice and loud: SNOW!
Every snowflake has six sides. So pretty!
Now we know how it works. Great job!
Here's a clue: you can't see it, but you can feel it! Can you guess?
How does it work? Let's find out!
When the sun warms the air, it moves around, whoosh!
Can you blow like the wind? Whoooosh!
One more time, nice and loud: WIND!
Windmills use wind to make electricity.
Now we know how it works. Great job!

recap: Wow, we learned so much! Let's remember.
outro: Which one was your favorite? Keep asking, how does that work?
Bye, friends! See you next time on Gizmo Explains!
